四档电脑难度 · 同屏 · 局域网

lines.en: Ten by ten. Twenty men each, and kings that fly.
lines.zh: 十乘十，双方各二十枚兵，还有纵横飞行的王。

lines.en: International Draughts. Every capture matters.
lines.zh: 国际跳棋。每一次吃子都算数。

lines.en: Men move forward, but capture in every direction.
lines.zh: 兵向前走，却可以向四个斜向吃子。

lines.en: Captures are mandatory — and the longest chain wins the move.
lines.zh: 吃子是强制的——必须走吃子最多的一条路线。

lines.en: A man that reaches the far row becomes a flying king.
lines.zh: 兵走到最远一行，就升为飞王。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from gentle Companion to deep Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手，从温和陪玩到深算挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins on the local network.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一局域网加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record. International Draughts.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。国际跳棋。

title: Big Two
tagline: Poker hands. One family table.
taglineZh: 扑克牌型，一家人一桌。

lines.en: Fifty-two cards. Four seats. Thirteen each.
lines.zh: 五十二张牌，四个座位，每人十三张。

lines.en: Big Two. Diamonds, clubs, hearts, spades.
lines.zh: 大老二。方块、梅花、红桃、黑桃。

lines.en: The holder of 3♦ leads, and the first play must include it.
lines.zh: 持有 ♦3 的玩家先出，首手必须带上它。

lines.en: Singles, pairs, triples, and five-card poker hands.
lines.zh: 单张、对子、三张，还有五张牌型。

lines.en: Straights, flushes, full houses, four plus one, straight flushes.
lines.zh: 顺子、同花、葫芦、四带一、同花顺。

lines.en: First to empty their hand wins. Every card left scores.
lines.zh: 最先出完手牌的人获胜，剩下的牌要算分。

lines.en: Four computer levels, hot-seat, and a private LAN table.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手、同屏热座，还有私密局域网牌桌。

lines.en: Offline. No account. No ads.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告。

title: Jungle Chess
tagline: Seven columns. Nine rows. One den.
taglineZh: 七列九行，一个兽穴。

lines.en: Seven columns. Nine rows. Two rivers.
lines.zh: 七列九行，两条河流。

lines.en: Jungle Chess. The classic Dou Shou Qi.
lines.zh: 斗兽棋，经典动物棋。

lines.en: Elephant, lion, tiger, rat. Rank decides who eats whom.
lines.zh: 大象、狮子、老虎、老鼠，等级决定谁能吃谁。

lines.en: Rats swim. Lions and tigers leap the river. Traps bring any animal down.
lines.zh: 老鼠会游泳，狮子老虎会跳河，陷阱能让任何动物降级。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from gentle Companion to a three-move Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑难度，从温和陪玩到向前算三步的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一局域网加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Jungle Chess. Enter the den, or capture them all.
lines.zh: 斗兽棋。进入兽穴，或吃光对方。

title: Sowing
tagline: Mancala sowing and capturing
taglineZh: 播种、收获，跟着节奏走。

lines.en: Twelve pits. Two stores. One rhythm.
lines.zh: 十二个坑，两个仓，一个节奏。

lines.en: Sowing. A mancala game for the family table.
lines.zh: 播棋。给家庭牌桌的曼卡拉。

lines.en: Lift a pit, sow counter-clockwise, and skip the other store.
lines.zh: 拿起一坑，逆时针播种，跳过对方的仓。

lines.en: Land in your store and sow again. Land empty and capture across.
lines.zh: 落进自己的仓就再来一回合；落进空坑就收对面。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to an eight-ply Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到八步挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record. Offline, no account.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。离线、无账号。

lines.en: Sowing. Keep the rhythm.
lines.zh: 播棋。跟着节奏走。

title: Hearts
tagline: Four seats. Mind the queen.
taglineZh: 四家一桌，小心皇后。

lines.en: A 52-card deck. Four seats. One queen to avoid.
lines.zh: 一副 52 张牌，四个座位，一张要躲开的皇后。

lines.en: Hearts. Pass three cards and take the trick.
lines.zh: 红心大战。传三张牌，收下每一墩。

lines.en: Left, right, across. Keep the dangerous cards moving.
lines.zh: 向左、向右、对家，把危险牌传出去。

lines.en: Follow suit. Every heart is a point, and so is the queen of spades.
lines.zh: 能跟就必须跟。每张红心一分，黑桃皇后十三分。

lines.en: Take all 26 points to shoot the moon and turn the table around.
lines.zh: 收下全部 26 分就是射月，整张牌桌都会翻转。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from a gentle companion to a counting challenge.
lines.zh: 四档电脑难度，从温和陪玩到会算牌的挑战。

lines.en: Four on one screen with a private curtain, or a phone joins over the local network.
lines.zh: 四人同屏有隐私幕帘，手机也能连局域网加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave, a family record, and no accounts.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存、家庭战绩，不用账号。

title: Sheng Ji
tagline: Two decks. Two partnerships. One level at a time.
taglineZh: 两副牌，两对搭档，一级一级往上打。

lines.en: One hundred and eight cards. Four players. Two partnerships.
lines.zh: 一百零八张牌，四个人，两对搭档。

lines.en: Sheng Ji. Two decks. One level at a time.
lines.zh: 升级。两副牌，一级一级往上打。

lines.en: Declare with a level card. A pair is stronger. A pair of jokers calls no-trump.
lines.zh: 用级牌叫主。一对更强，一对王可以叫无主。

lines.en: The declarer takes the bottom, buries eight, and leads.
lines.zh: 庄家拿底牌、扣八张，然后领出第一墩。

lines.en: Follow the led group. Pair with pair, tractor with tractor, or ruff with trump.
lines.zh: 跟着桌面走：对子跟对子，拖拉机跟拖拉机，或者用主牌将吃。

lines.en: Take 5, 10 and K. Eighty points upgrades one level; a shutout jumps three.
lines.zh: 拿走 5、10、K。八十分升一级，零分连升三级。

lines.en: Four computer levels, a private hot-seat, and a LAN table.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、私密同屏，还有局域网牌桌。

lines.en: Offline. No account. No ads.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告。

title: Tables
tagline: Roll, race, and bring everyone home.
taglineZh: 掷骰、奔跑，把每一枚棋子送回家。

lines.en: Roll two dice. Race every checker home.
lines.zh: 掷两颗骰子，把每一枚棋子送回家。

lines.en: Tables. Backgammon at the family table.
lines.zh: 双陆棋。家庭牌桌上的西洋双陆。

lines.en: Hit a blot and send it to the bar. Two checkers make a safe point.
lines.zh: 打中孤子，把它送回中线；两枚棋子才能守住一个点。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a Hard that samples your next rolls.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到会模拟你下一掷的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者让手机连上同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints with reasons, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 带理由的提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: No doubling cube. No account. No ads.
lines.zh: 没有加倍骰、没有账号、没有广告。

lines.en: Tables. Roll, race, and bring everyone home.
lines.zh: 双陆棋。掷骰、奔跑，把大家送回家。

title: Liar's Dice
tagline: Five dice. One table. Nobody knows what is under the cups.
taglineZh: 五颗骰子，一桌胆量。

lines.en: Five dice each, hidden under a cup.
lines.zh: 每人五颗骰子，藏在骰盅下。

lines.en: Liar's Dice. Bid a quantity and a face.
lines.zh: 吹牛骰。叫一个数量和一个点数。

lines.en: Three fours. Raise the quantity, raise the face, or challenge.
lines.zh: 三个四点。加数量、加点数，或者开骰。

lines.en: Ones are wild. Nobody sees your cup.
lines.zh: 一点万能，没人看得见你的骰盅。

lines.en: A true bid costs the challenger a die. A false bid costs the bidder.
lines.zh: 叫点成立，开骰者输一颗；叫点不成立，叫点者输一颗。

lines.en: Last player with dice wins the table.
lines.zh: 最后手里还有骰子的人赢下牌桌。

lines.en: Four computer levels, hot-seat, and tables on your own network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、同屏热座，还有局域网牌桌。

lines.en: Spot on, hints, undo and a family record. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 正好、提示、悔棋和家庭战绩。离线、无账号、无广告。

title: Race Home
tagline: A four-colour race around the house
taglineZh: 四色棋子，绕着房子跑回家

lines.en: Four colours. Four pawns each. One way home.
lines.zh: 四种颜色，每色四枚棋子，一起跑回家。

lines.en: Race Home. A Ludo-like race for the whole table.
lines.zh: 飞行棋。给全家人的绕圈比赛。

lines.en: Roll a six to open the yard, then race around the ring.
lines.zh: 掷出 6 让棋子出家门，再沿跑道向前。

lines.en: Land on a rival and send it back home.
lines.zh: 落在对手格子上，把对方送回老家。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a one-ply Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到一步预判的挑战。

lines.en: Hot-seat for two to four, or phones join over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 二到四人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Undo, hints, autosave and a family record. Offline and ad-free.
lines.zh: 悔棋、提示、自动保存和家庭战绩。离线、无广告。

lines.en: Race Home. Roll, race, arrive.
lines.zh: 飞行棋。掷骰、绕圈、到家。

title: Spades
tagline: Four seats. Two partnerships. One deck.
taglineZh: 四个座位，两对搭档，一副牌。

lines.en: Four seats. Two partnerships. One deck.
lines.zh: 四个座位，两对搭档，一副牌。

lines.en: Spades. The partnership card table.
lines.zh: 黑桃皇后。搭档的牌桌。

lines.en: Bid your tricks. Spades are always trump.
lines.zh: 先叫墩数。黑桃永远是王牌。

lines.en: Follow suit, break spades, and cover your partner.
lines.zh: 跟花色、破黑桃，替搭档兜底。

lines.en: Go nil for a hundred, or blind nil for two.
lines.zh: 零墩奖一百，盲零墩奖两百。

lines.en: Four AI levels, hot-seat, or four phones on one network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、四人同屏，或同一网络的四部手机。

lines.en: Bags, bag penalties, and a race to five hundred.
lines.zh: 袋分、罚分，一路打到五百分。

lines.en: Spades. Deal the next hand.
lines.zh: 黑桃皇后。发下一手牌。

title: Idiom Chain
tagline: One idiom. One last character. One chain.
taglineZh: 一个成语，一个字，一条接龙。
factsZh: 680 个成语 · 拼音 + 释义

lines.en: A chain of Chinese idioms around one table.
lines.zh: 一家人围桌，一句接一句。

lines.en: Idiom Chain. The last character opens the next.
lines.zh: 成语接龙。上一个的末字，就是下一个的开头。

lines.en: Play any idiom to begin. Then keep the last character alive.
lines.zh: 先出任意一个成语开局，再让最后一个字一直走下去。

lines.en: Fifteen seconds a turn. A rare idiom adds two points.
lines.zh: 每回合十五秒，生僻成语加两分。

lines.en: Three hint-free idioms in a row earn a bonus.
lines.zh: 连续三个不靠提示，再加一分。

lines.en: Four computer levels search the dictionary by first character.
lines.zh: 四档电脑，都按首字查词典。

lines.en: Two to six players on one screen, or phones on the same Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 二到六人同屏，或手机连同一无线网络。

lines.en: Idiom Chain. Keep the last character going.
lines.zh: 成语接龙。让最后一个字继续。

title: Ladder Run
tagline: Roll, climb, slide, giggle.
taglineZh: 掷骰、爬梯、滑下、开怀。

lines.en: One board. A hundred squares. No decisions.
lines.zh: 一张棋盘，一百格。不用做决定。

lines.en: Ladder Run — snakes and ladders for the whole family.
lines.zh: 蛇梯棋——全家人的蛇梯棋。

lines.en: Roll the die. Climb a ladder. Slip down a snake.
lines.zh: 掷骰子。爬梯子。滑下蛇。

lines.en: Two to four players pass one device, or join from a phone.
lines.zh: 二到四人同屏轮流，或手机加入。

lines.en: The AI never decides. It just rolls, and the level changes the company.
lines.zh: AI 不做决定，只负责掷骰；档位只改变陪玩语气。

lines.en: A hint shows all six faces. Undo and autosave keep the table kind.
lines.zh: 提示会列出六种点数；悔棋和自动保存让牌桌更轻松。

lines.en: Exact roll to land on one hundred. First home wins.
lines.zh: 必须正好落在 100；先到家的人获胜。

lines.en: Ladder Run. Roll, climb, slide, giggle.
lines.zh: 蛇梯棋。掷骰、爬梯、滑下、开怀。

title: Rummy 500
tagline: Draw. Meld. Lay off. Reach 500.
taglineZh: 摸牌。组牌。接牌。先到五百分。
factsZh: 悔棋 + 提示 + 自动保存

lines.en: A deck, a table, and a race to five hundred.
lines.zh: 一副牌，一张桌，先到五百分。

lines.en: Rummy 500. Draw, meld, lay off.
lines.zh: 五百分拉米。摸牌、组牌、接牌。

lines.en: Take the stock, or dig into the discard pile.
lines.zh: 摸牌堆，或从弃牌堆里取牌。

lines.en: Sets, runs, and lay-offs on anyone's meld.
lines.zh: 套牌、顺子，还能接任何人的牌组。

lines.en: Aces play high or low. Table cards score; hand cards cost.
lines.zh: A 可大可小。桌上的牌加分，手里的牌减分。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to a careful Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手，从温和陪玩到谨慎挑战。

lines.en: Pass one device, or join from a phone over the local network.
lines.zh: 一台设备传着玩，或手机连同一网络加入。

lines.en: First to 500 wins. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 先到 500 分获胜。离线、无账号、无广告。

title: Cribbage
tagline: Thirty-one, and a little luck.
taglineZh: 凑到三十一，也碰一点运气。

lines.en: Six cards each. Discard two. Cut for the starter.
lines.zh: 每人六张，弃两张，再切起始牌。

lines.en: Cribbage. Thirty-one, and a little luck.
lines.zh: 克里比奇。凑到三十一，也碰一点运气。

lines.en: Peg to fifteen and thirty-one. Pairs and runs score too.
lines.zh: 出牌凑十五和三十一，对子与顺子也能得分。

lines.en: Count your hand with the starter, then the dealer counts the crib.
lines.zh: 手牌加起始牌计数，庄家最后数弃牌堆。

lines.en: First to 121 wins. Four computer levels, from gentle to sharp.
lines.zh: 先到 121 分获胜；四档电脑，从温和到犀利。

lines.en: Two to four players on one screen, or a phone joins over the network.
lines.zh: 两到四人同屏，手机也能连同一网络加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave, and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔牌、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Cribbage. Deal the first hand.
lines.zh: 克里比奇。发第一手牌吧。

title: Nanchang Mahjong
tagline: Four seats. One wall. Seven spirits.
taglineZh: 四个座位，一座牌墙，七张精。
factsZh: 单机 · 同屏 · 局域网

lines.en: Four seats. One wall. Seven spirits.
lines.zh: 四个座位，一座牌墙，七张精。

lines.en: Nanchang Mahjong. True and secondary spirits change every hand.
lines.zh: 南昌麻将。正精副精，每手都变。

lines.en: Flip the wall-end tile. Three true spirits, four secondary.
lines.zh: 翻开牌墙末端。三张正精，四张副精。

lines.en: Chi, peng, kong. Winds and dragons run in threes.
lines.zh: 吃、碰、杠。风牌箭牌三张成顺。

lines.en: German, spirit sprint, robbing a kong, seven-star thirteen scattered.
lines.zh: 德国、冲关、抢杠、七星十三烂。

lines.en: Four AI levels with wild-tile efficiency and defence.
lines.zh: 四档电脑，会算精、会防守。

lines.en: Solo, hot-seat with privacy, or four seats on one network.
lines.zh: 单机、同屏盖牌，或同一网络四座位。

lines.en: Nanchang Mahjong. Read the spirits.
lines.zh: 南昌麻将。看懂精牌。

title: Pair Up
tagline: Flip two. Find the pair. Share the sweets.
taglineZh: 翻开两张，配成一对，分享甜点。

lines.en: Sixteen face-down desserts. Find the pairs.
lines.zh: 十六张甜点暗牌，找出成对的它们。

lines.en: Pair Up. A memory game for the whole table.
lines.zh: 翻牌记忆。给一整桌人的记忆游戏。

lines.en: Flip two cards. A match stays open, scores, and you go again.
lines.zh: 翻开两张。配对成功就留下、得分，再翻一次。

lines.en: A miss turns back and passes the turn clockwise.
lines.zh: 没配上就翻回去，轮到下一位。

lines.en: Two to six players on one screen, or phones joining over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 2–6 人同屏轮流，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Four AI levels: Companion forgets on purpose; Hard remembers every card.
lines.zh: 四档 AI：陪玩会故意忘牌，挑战记得每一张。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a local family record. No account, no ads.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和本机家庭战绩。无账号、无广告。

lines.en: Pair Up. Flip two. Find the pair.
lines.zh: 翻牌记忆。翻开两张，配成一对。

title: Abalone
tagline: Push six out. Hold the centre.
taglineZh: 推出六颗，守住中路。
factsZh: 单人 · 同屏 · 局域网

lines.en: Sixty-one points. Fourteen marbles each.
lines.zh: 六十一个点位，双方各十四颗棋子。

lines.en: Abalone. Push six out. Hold the centre.
lines.zh: 大力士棋。推出六颗，守住中路。

lines.en: Move one, two or three marbles in a line.
lines.zh: 每次沿直线移动一到三颗棋子。

lines.en: Slide, push, and send the enemy off the rim.
lines.zh: 横移、前推，把对方棋子送出场外。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from gentle Companion to Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手，从温和陪玩到挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一无线网络加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Offline, no account, no ads. Abalone.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告。大力士棋。

title: Domino Line
tagline: Line up. Block out. Domino.
taglineZh: 排成一线，堵住对手，收下牌局。

lines.en: Twenty-eight tiles. One line. First to a hundred.
lines.zh: 二十八张骨牌，一条牌线，先到一百分。

lines.en: Domino Line — block dominoes for the whole table.
lines.zh: 多米诺——适合全家人的堵桌骨牌。

lines.en: Match a pip, draw when stuck, and empty your hand.
lines.zh: 接点数，没牌就摸，先出完手牌。

lines.en: Two to four players, on one screen or a phone across the Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 二到四人，一台设备，或者同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to a Hard that samples unseen tiles.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到会采样未见牌的挑战。

lines.en: Hints explain the move. Undo and autosave keep the table friendly.
lines.zh: 提示会说明理由；悔棋和自动保存让牌桌更轻松。

lines.en: The winner starts the next round; a blocked table goes to the fewest pips.
lines.zh: 本局赢家开下一局；牌桌堵死时点数最少者胜。

lines.en: Domino Line. Line up. Block out. Domino.
lines.zh: 多米诺。排成一线，堵住对手。

title: Color Chain
tagline: Match, shed, and keep the chain going.
taglineZh: 接颜色，接数字，先出完手牌。

lines.en: Four colours. One chain.
lines.zh: 四种颜色，一条牌链。

lines.en: Color Chain. A shedding game for the family table.
lines.zh: 颜色接龙。给全家人的出牌游戏。

lines.en: Match the colour or the number, and keep the chain moving.
lines.zh: 接颜色、接数字，让牌链一直走下去。

lines.en: Skip, reverse, draw two — or call a colour with a wild.
lines.zh: 跳过、反转、罚两张——万能牌还能改颜色。

lines.en: Empty your hand first. Leave the fewest points when the match hits two hundred.
lines.zh: 先出完手牌；总分到 200 时，分最低的人赢。

lines.en: Four AI levels, or two to six players on one screen and over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 四档 AI；二到六人同屏，或连同一 Wi-Fi。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。离线、无账号、无广告。

lines.en: Color Chain. Keep the chain going.
lines.zh: 颜色接龙。让牌链接下去。

title: Hive
tagline: One hive. Six sides. One queen.
taglineZh: 一个蜂巢，六面围杀，一位蜂后。

lines.en: One hive. Six sides. One queen.
lines.zh: 一个蜂巢，六个面，一位蜂后。

lines.en: Hive. A full base-set duel for the family table.
lines.zh: 虫虫棋。给全家人的完整基础对局。

lines.en: Place, slide, climb and jump. Keep the hive in one piece.
lines.zh: 放子、滑行、攀爬、跳跃。蜂巢始终连成一体。

lines.en: Four computer levels, from gentle Companion to a three-ply Hard.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手，从温和陪玩到三层搜索的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over the local network.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机在同一网络中扫码加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告。

lines.en: Hive. Surround the queen.
lines.zh: 虫虫棋。围住蜂后。

title: Five Dice
tagline: Five dice. Thirteen boxes. One winner.
taglineZh: 五颗骰子，十三个格子，一位赢家。

lines.en: Five dice. Three rolls. Thirteen boxes.
lines.zh: 五颗骰子，三次机会，十三个格子。

lines.en: Five Dice. A Yahtzee-like table for the whole family.
lines.zh: 五骰。给全家人的 Yahtzee 式骰子桌。

lines.en: Roll the dice. Keep the ones you like. Reroll the rest.
lines.zh: 掷出骰子，留下想要的，再把其余的重新掷。

lines.en: Fill every box once. Chase straights, full houses and five of a kind.
lines.zh: 每个格子填一次，追顺子、葫芦和五条。

lines.en: Reach 63 upstairs for the 35-point bonus.
lines.zh: 上区满 63 分，拿下 35 分奖励。

lines.en: Four AI levels, two to four players, or a phone over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 四档 AI、二到四人同屏，或者手机连 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、撤销、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Five Dice. Roll. Keep. Score.
lines.zh: 五骰。掷、留、记分。

title: Fleet
tagline: Ten columns. Five ships. One quiet sea.
taglineZh: 十列海图，五艘战舰，一片安静的海。

lines.en: A hundred squares. Nobody knows where the fleet is.
lines.zh: 一百个格子，谁也不知道舰队藏在哪里。

lines.en: Fleet. Hide five ships, then hunt.
lines.zh: 海战棋。藏好五艘船，再去猎杀。

lines.en: Carrier, battleship, cruiser, submarine, destroyer.
lines.zh: 航母、战列舰、巡洋舰、潜艇、驱逐舰。

lines.en: Fire one shot per turn. Miss, hit, sunk.
lines.zh: 每回合开一炮。未中、命中、击沉。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to probability-counting Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到计算所有船位的挑战。

lines.en: Two captains on one screen, or a phone across the Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两位舰长同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints with reasons, undo, autosave and a family logbook.
lines.zh: 有理由的提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭航海日志。

lines.en: Fleet. Ten columns. Five ships. One quiet sea.
lines.zh: 海战棋。十列海图，五艘战舰，一片安静的海。

title: President
tagline: Climb the table. Do not finish last.
taglineZh: 一级一级往上打，别做最后一名。

lines.en: Fifty-two cards. Three to six players.
lines.zh: 五十二张牌，三到六个人。

lines.en: President. Climb the table.
lines.zh: 排位赛。一级一级往上打。

lines.en: Play singles, pairs and triples. Equal or higher takes the trick.
lines.zh: 出单张、对子或三张，点数不小于桌面就能压住。

lines.en: Pass to save your twos, or take control.
lines.zh: 过牌留住 2，或者拿下这一墩。

lines.en: Finish first to become President. Finish last and you are Scum.
lines.zh: 第一个出完当总统，最后一名是末位。

lines.en: Next round, the President takes the Scum's best cards.
lines.zh: 下一局，总统收下末位最好的牌。

lines.en: Four computer levels, hot-seat, and play on your own network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑对手、同屏热座，还有局域网。

lines.en: Offline. No account. No ads.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告。

title: Codebreak
tagline: Four pegs. Six colours. One secret.
taglineZh: 四枚色钉，六种颜色，一个秘密。

lines.en: Four pegs. Six colours. One hidden code.
lines.zh: 四枚色钉，六种颜色，一个藏起来的密码。

lines.en: Codebreak — the family code-breaking game.
lines.zh: 猜色——全家一起破解密码。

lines.en: The setter hides a code. The breaker has ten guesses.
lines.zh: 一人藏密码，一人有十次机会。

lines.en: Black means right colour and place. White means right colour, wrong place.
lines.zh: 黑色代表颜色和位置都对，白色代表颜色对、位置不对。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to Knuth-style Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温柔陪玩到 Knuth 式挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi. The code stays hidden.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。密码始终藏好。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Codebreak. Crack the code.
lines.zh: 猜色。来破解密码吧。

title: Triple Find
tagline: Three cards. Four clues. One sharp eye.
taglineZh: 三张牌，四条线索，一双快眼。
factsZh: 81 张牌 · 每张四条线索
四档 AI · 种子确定性
同屏 + 局域网 + 自动保存

lines.en: Twelve cards on the table. Four clues on every one.
lines.zh: 桌上十二张牌，每张四条线索。

lines.en: Triple Find. Three cards, one sharp eye.
lines.zh: 三连找。三张牌，一双快眼。

lines.en: A set is all-same or all-different in every clue: colour, shape, fill and count.
lines.zh: 一组牌，颜色、形状、填充、数量，每条线索都要么全一样，要么全不同。

lines.en: Spot it, call it, score it. The first caller takes the point.
lines.zh: 看到就喊，喊对得分。先喊的人拿下这一分。

lines.en: No set on the table? Three more cards are dealt.
lines.zh: 桌上没有组？自动补三张牌。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to an instant Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到瞬间出手的挑战。

lines.en: Two to four on one screen, or phones joining over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 二到四人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Five minutes. Highest score wins. Triple Find.
lines.zh: 五分钟，最高分获胜。三连找。

title: Little Go
tagline: A small board. A quiet game for the whole family.
taglineZh: 一张小棋盘，一家人安静下一局。

lines.en: Eighty-one crossings. Black moves first.
lines.zh: 八十一个交叉点，黑棋先行。

lines.en: Little Go. A small board, a quiet game for the whole family.
lines.zh: 小围棋。一张小棋盘，一家人安静下一局。

lines.en: Place stones, surround ground, and capture groups without liberties.
lines.zh: 落子、围地，提掉没有气的棋。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from gentle Companion to a 200-playout Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到 200 次推演的挑战。

lines.en: Two players on one screen, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 两人同屏，或者手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Undo, a hint with a reason, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 悔棋、带理由的提示、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: White gets 6.5 komi. Two passes end the game and the board shows the count.
lines.zh: 白棋贴 6.5 目。双方连续停一手，棋盘直接标出数子结果。

lines.en: Little Go. A quiet game for Family Arcade.
lines.zh: 小围棋。Family Arcade 的一局安静棋。

title: Mini Chess
tagline: Small board. Real chess.
taglineZh: 小棋盘，真棋局。
facts: No queens · promote to rook, bishop or knight
factsZh: 无皇后 · 兵可升变为车、象、马

lines.en: Five files. Six ranks. Ten pieces a side.
lines.zh: 五列，六行，每方十子。

lines.en: Mini Chess — an original chess variant for the family table.
lines.zh: 迷你棋——给家庭牌桌的原创国际象棋变体。

lines.en: No queens. Pawns still promote to a rook, bishop or knight.
lines.zh: 没有皇后。兵依然可以升变为车、象或马。

lines.en: Check, checkmate and stalemate use the rules you know.
lines.zh: 将军、将死、无子可动，都是熟悉的规则。

lines.en: Four AI levels, from a gentle Companion to a five-ply Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI，从温和陪玩到五层搜索的挑战。

lines.en: Pass one screen, or let a phone join over the same Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 一台设备传着下，或让手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Hints, undo, autosave and a family record.
lines.zh: 提示、悔棋、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Mini Chess. Small board. Real chess.
lines.zh: 迷你棋。小棋盘，真棋局。

title: Hex
tagline: Two edges. One unbroken line.
taglineZh: 两条边，一条不断的线。

lines.en: A board of hexagons. Two players. No draws.
lines.zh: 一张六角棋盘，两位玩家，没有平局。

lines.en: Hex. Red joins north to south; Blue joins west to east.
lines.zh: 六角棋。红方连接南北，蓝方连接东西。

lines.en: Place one stone. Build an unbroken chain through neighbouring hexes.
lines.zh: 放下一枚棋子，用相邻的六角格连成一条不断的线。

lines.en: Four AI levels: a gentle Companion, Easy, Normal, and a searching Hard.
lines.zh: 四档 AI：温和陪玩、轻松、标准，以及认真搜索的挑战。

lines.en: Play solo, pass one screen, or let a phone join over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 单人、同屏热座，或者让手机通过 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Ask the coach for a hint and hear the reason, not just the hex.
lines.zh: 向教练要一个提示，听到理由，而不只是一个格子。

lines.en: Undo, autosave, and a family record that stays on this device.
lines.zh: 悔棋、自动保存，还有留在这台设备上的家庭战绩。

lines.en: Hex. Two edges. One unbroken line.
lines.zh: 六角棋。两条边，一条不断的线。

title: Mahjong
tagline: Draw. Read. Win.
taglineZh: 摸牌 · 读牌 · 胡牌
facts: Four melds · seven pairs · thirteen orphans
factsZh: 四副一将 · 七对 · 十三幺
悔棋 · 提示 · 自动保存

lines.en: 136 tiles. Four seats. One wall.
lines.zh: 136 张牌，四个座位，一道牌墙。

lines.en: Mahjong. The family tile table.
lines.zh: 麻将。家里的牌桌。

lines.en: Draw one, discard one. Build four melds and a pair.
lines.zh: 摸一张，打一张。做四副一将。

lines.en: Chow from the left. Pong, kong, and rob the kong.
lines.zh: 只能吃上家。碰、杠，还能抢杠。

lines.en: Seven pairs, thirteen orphans, or a clean pure straight.
lines.zh: 七对、十三幺，或者漂亮的一气通贯。

lines.en: Four computer levels, four on one screen, or four phones.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、四人同屏，或四部手机。

lines.en: Every fan counted, every hand private.
lines.zh: 每一番都算清，每一手牌都保密。

lines.en: Mahjong. Deal the next hand.
lines.zh: 麻将。发下一手牌。
